_comment: STT biasing for Grace. 'initial_prompt' primes Whisper with context (style + that Mikkel mixes Danish with English tech terms). 'hotwords' is a vocabulary list that nudges Whisper toward these exact spellings when it hears something close. Keep the combined size modest (~Whisper caps the prompt around 224 tokens) — prioritise words that get mis-heard. Edit freely; no rebuild needed, the STT server reads this on startup.
initial_prompt: Samtale med Grace, en dansk AI-assistent. Hej Grace. Mikkel taler dansk, ofte blandet med engelske tekniske og kode-relaterede ord.
